exposure: Meeting vs not meeting the Healthy People 2020 goal for NTSV cesarean birth rate
cohort: 400 providers of intrapartum care in California, 209 of whom completed surveys and 109 of whom perform cesareans
finding: Providers' attitudes towards birth, particularly those more favorable towards vaginal birth, were significantly associated with lower NTSV cesarean rates.
mod_finding: Providers meeting the Healthy People 2020 goal for NTSV cesarean birth rate held attitudes more favorable towards vaginal birth.
